body:
Remove the text shown under the task viewer's action buttons that names the model each action will use (e.g. "Model: B").

The actions themselves keep running on the same model as now; only the text goes.

For the agent: the line comes from `solace_task.action_model_label`, used only by `solace_task.action_view`. The test `planning_actions_use_their_roles_model_test` checks for this text and will need its `Model: …` checks removed (the checks on which model each action sends stay).
title: task viewer: drop model line under action buttons
